title: Render worker: replace the hard-coded password with IAM auth
description: apps/studio-web/amplify/backend.ts passes WORKER_PASSWORD='BabulusRenderWorker2026!' to the render-worker container, which signs in to Cognito as render-worker@babulus.internal. The repo is public and the password is in git history, so treat it as burned. Before rendering is used in the new account: give the worker AppSync access through its ECS task role (IAM auth on the Job/related models), drop WORKER_EMAIL/WORKER_PASSWORD, and never create a Cognito user with that password.
